title: ContextLedgerQuarantineRegisterEntry
description: One hash-chained record of a source REFUSED at pre-admission because it carried credential material. WHY THIS IS A SEPARATE CONTRACT RATHER THAN AN evidence-ledger-entry WITH redactionState=QUARANTINED_SECRET: that entry requires contentHash, encryption.plaintextHash, encryption.ciphertextHash and a storageLocator, and every one of those can only be produced by admitting the bytes. Representing a refusal there would force exactly the capture the refusal exists to prevent. This register therefore records METADATA ONLY -- never content, never a content hash, never a digest of a matched value, never the surrounding bytes. A digest of a secret is a confirmation oracle for anyone holding a candidate, so 'we only stored the hash' is not a defence and is refused here by contract. The register is appended with the SAME compare-and-swap hash chain as the evidence ledger, pointed at its own root, so a refusal is exactly as tamper-evident as a capture. Absence of a source from the evidence ledger plus presence here is the complete, auditable account of what happened to it.

seq.description: Ordering assistance only, exactly as in the evidence ledger. Identity is entryHash.

refusalId.description: Stable identity of THIS refusal, derived from METADATA ONLY: source path, byte size, mtime, scanner version, and the offsets/lengths of the findings. Never from the file's bytes and never from a matched value, so it cannot serve as a confirmation oracle -- which is exactly why the obvious identity, a content hash, is refused here. It exists so re-scanning an unchanged source binds to the existing record instead of appending a second one; without it the register grows by the entire quarantine set on every run and reads as though the same credential were found again and again.

disposition.description: A terminal NON-CAPTURE state. Not a degraded capture, not a failure, and never counted toward captured totals.

payloadCaptured.description: MUST be false. Asserted rather than implied so that a verifier can refuse the record instead of inferring safety from the absence of other fields.

contentHashWithheld.description: MUST be true. No contentHash exists for this source anywhere in the archive, by design.

sourceClass.description: Discovery class that owned this source, e.g. claude-code-preserved.

sourcePath.description: Where the credential material lives NOW. This is remediation-critical: a refusal a human cannot act on is only half a control.

scannerVersion.description: Which detector version made this decision. A later version with different coverage must be distinguishable, or a re-scan cannot be reasoned about.

findings.description: Location and shape only. additionalProperties:false is the enforcement point -- it is what makes it impossible to add a 'valueSample' or 'valueHash' field later without changing the contract in public.

remediation.description: The required human action. Re-admission is never automatic: a detector that could clear its own finding would make quarantine advisory.
